objective: Test whether an additive delta-tree — specialize failure-mode leaves, compress by accumulating validated deltas into a root that is >= the flat base by construction — beats the flat rubric, and whether a localized source->edited change signal improves the partial boundary.
baseline_preservation: Cali-Tree v2 is unchanged and is the default (specialization_mode=replace). The delta-tree is opt-in via specialization_mode=additive; Rubric-Lite v4 is also untouched.
hypotheses: H1 (accumulation): with additive leaves + no-regression-vs-base merge guard, the root is the accumulated widest merge and its held-out accuracy is >= the flat base rubric (routed <= flat can no longer happen).
H2 (failure-mode clustering): grouping leaves by (base-prediction, target) residual signature yields fewer, better-supported leaves and more accepted merges than task grouping.
H3 (partial signal): attaching the localized change map + descriptor raises partial F1 versus the same tree with change_signal=off.

dataset.name: ImagenHub/Text_Guided_Image_Editing
dataset.development_status: The 120-case dev slice and the 1,200-case held-out are development/ablation data, not untouched confirmation.

model.merge_objective: balanced (no regression vs base on the held-out guard)

change_signal_feature.inputs: SOURCE + EDITED luminance change map + textual descriptor (changed extent, 3x3 grid location, background-preserved flag)
change_signal_feature.deps: numpy (core) + Pillow (calitree extra); cached by (item_id, source sha, edited sha, config hash, version)
change_signal_feature.target_blind: the change map is computed from source/edited pixels only; it never sees the human label

advancement_gate: The delta-root held-out accuracy must be >= the flat base rubric (H1), and the change signal must raise partial F1 by a preregistered margin (H3) before any full-1200 or second-dataset run. Otherwise stop and record the negative result.

comparison.flat_base_rubric_held_out_accuracy: measured in-run as the base/warm node

reserved: The untouched EditInspector final 391-case partition is not part of this experiment.
